protocol.label_policy: Original train-visit RxCUI vocabulary; no product/brand/ingredient merging
protocol.cohort_policy: Retain all A1 cases and patient splits, including unseen targets and unsupported inputs
protocol.input_policy: Strict rejection of unknown diagnosis, procedure or historical medication codes; rejected rows have NaN scores and an explicit availability mask
protocol.target_policy: Unseen target RxCUIs remain false negatives in full-target Jaccard/F1
protocol.model_selection: Maximum validation full-target mean Jaccard across all 355 cases; rejected inputs score zero; earliest epoch wins ties
protocol.average_precision: Supported inputs with every target in the training vocabulary only; report subset size and coverage
protocol.ddi_policy: Same 40 least-frequent event-group selection; complete unique ingredient-CID mappings only; partial positive evidence reported separately
